prompt: The same scene at night. Through the window, the homestead sleeps under a deep plum-brown sky with no stars and no moon: the barn and fruit trees are dark silhouettes, and one window of the farmhouse glows warm. In the room, the desk lamp is switched on and casts a warm amber-orange pool of light across the desk and the open sketchbook; the laptop screen glows softly; the room falls into warm shadow away from the lamp. Keep the exact composition, camera, framing, every object and its position, and the same pixel-art style: the strict, even grid of 4 by 4 screen pixels per art pixel, no anti-aliasing, consistent one-art-pixel outlines, hand-placed dithering. Palette for the dark theme: deep warm brown-black (#1A1612), dark umber (#241F19), muted taupe (#A8998A), cream highlights (#EFE6D2), deep plum and blue-grey night shadows, and warm orange light (#E8743B). Keep the transparent background around the vignette, with nothing outside it. No people, no animals, no text, no logos, no stars, no moon, no sparkles, no fireflies.
